traitDescriptions.supreme_sidestepper: Makes it much easier to avoid enemy attacks.
traitDescriptions.ultra_crafty_zammer: Greatly increases the damage inflicted by dark-elemental attacks.
traitDescriptions.rando-panic: Sometimes uses Wave of Panic during battle.
traitDescriptions.metal_skin: Reduces damage received by 1/3, but doubles the MP consumption of spells and abilities.
traitDescriptions.rando-disrupt: Sometimes uses Disruptive Wave during battle.
traitDescriptions.critical_sensation: Makes it much easier to inflict critical hits.
traitDescriptions.ultra_crafty_debilitator: Makes it much easier to reduce an enemy's attack, defence, agility or wisdom.
traitDescriptions.bangmeister: Increases the potency of explosive attacks and decreases their MP consumption.
traitDescriptions.zammeister: Increases the potency of dark-elemental attacks and decreases their MP consumption.
traitDescriptions.insult_to_injury: Increases damage inflicted on enemies that are poisoned, severely poisoned, stunned, asleep, confused or paralysed.
traitDescriptions.demonsbane: Increases damage inflicted on monsters from the demon family and slightly lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.decontaminate: Sometimes cures allies of sleep, confusion, poison, severe poison, paralysis and stun during battle.
traitDescriptions.low_heal: Sometimes restores 30 or more HP to all allies during battle. Higher wisdom makes the healing effect more powerful.
traitDescriptions.sizzmeister: Increases the potency of light-elemental attacks and decreases their MP consumption.
traitDescriptions.major_downer: Extends the duration of skills that lower the strength, defence, agility or wisdom of enemies to 5 turns. In addition, randomly prevents breath attacks, critical hits or the casting of magic, or bedazzles the enemy.
traitDescriptions.naked_ambition: Increases the likelihood of critical hits and critical spells if no accessory is equipped.
traitDescriptions.critical_mastermind: Makes it much easier to cast critical spells.
traitDescriptions.wooshmeister: Increases the potency of wind-elemental attacks and decreases their MP consumption.
traitDescriptions.confusing_touch: Regular attacks sometimes confuse the enemy.
traitDescriptions.uber_dragonsbane: Greatly increases damage inflicted on monsters from the dragon family and somewhat lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.metal_beater: Inflicts additional damage on enemies. A higher level increases the effect. Works on enemies with the Metal Skin trait.
traitDescriptions.attacking_impulse: Increases damage inflicted when HP drop to 1/2.
traitDescriptions.late_bloomer: Increases attack, defence, agility and wisdom from round 3 onwards, and even more so from round 6.
traitDescriptions.insta-ping: Monster sometimes casts Ping on itself at the start of battle.
traitDescriptions.sleepy_touch: Regular attacks sometimes put the enemy to sleep.
traitDescriptions.beastsbane: Increases damage inflicted on monsters from the beast family and slightly lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.ultra_crafty_sleeper: Makes it much easier to put the enemy to sleep.
traitDescriptions.stunning_touch: Regular attacks sometimes stun the enemy for 1 turn.
traitDescriptions.intimidating: Sometimes stuns the enemy during battle for 1 turn.
traitDescriptions.desperate_measures: Negates all damage suffered from critical hits and critical spells.
traitDescriptions.magical_moment: Makes it easier to cast critical spells when HP drops to 1/2, and even more so when HP drops to 1/4.
traitDescriptions.uber_beastsbane: Greatly increases damage inflicted on monsters from the beast family and somewhat lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.insta-bounce: Monster sometimes casts Bounce on itself at the start of battle.
traitDescriptions.stunning_skin: Sometimes stuns enemies that inflict direct attacks for 1 turn.
traitDescriptions.sleep_twitch: Attacks all enemies when the monster is asleep.
traitDescriptions.uber_zombiesbane: Greatly increases damage inflicted on monsters from the undead family and somewhat lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.ultra_crafty_splasher: Greatly increases the damage inflicted by water-elemental attacks.
traitDescriptions.static_discharge: Sometimes paralyses enemies that inflict direct attacks when the monster is paralysed itself.
traitDescriptions.uber_slimesbane: Greatly increases damage inflicted on monsters from the slime family and somewhat lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.uber_demonsbane: Greatly increases damage inflicted on monsters from the demon family and somewhat lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.hothead: Makes it easier to activate a frenzied state, turning the monster into a formidable fighting force.
traitDescriptions.uber_naturesbane: Greatly increases damage inflicted on monsters from the nature family and somewhat lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.slimesbane: Increases damage inflicted on monsters from the slime family and slightly lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.bossesbane: Increases damage inflicted on monsters from the ??? family and slightly lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.ultra_crafty_sizzer: Greatly increases the damage inflicted by light-elemental attacks.
traitDescriptions.ultra_crafty_magic_drainer: Makes it much easier to absorb MP.
traitDescriptions.somnolent_skin: Sometimes puts enemies that inflict direct attacks to sleep.
traitDescriptions.zombiesbane: Increases damage inflicted on monsters from the undead family and slightly lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.snappy_comeback: Inflicts damage back on an enemy that lands a killer blow. The amount inflicted is proportional to the excess damage suffered after the monster's HP are reduced to zero.
traitDescriptions.matterbane: Increases damage inflicted on monsters from the material family and slightly lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.ultra_crafty_whacker: Makes it much easier to kill the enemy instantly.
traitDescriptions.dragonsbane: Increases damage inflicted on monsters from the dragon family and slightly lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.naturesbane: Increases damage inflicted on monsters from the nature family and slightly lowers all resistances.
traitDescriptions.crafty_devil: Makes it moderately easier to inflict status ailments on the enemy.
